title: [microsoft/vscode] Fix issue #330352: clear stale terminal search highlights
description:
Fix GitHub issue #330352 in microsoft/vscode:
https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/330352

Repo: https://github.com/microsoft/vscode

Deliver a focused code fix so closing/repeating terminal Find searches does not leave stale highlights behind. Add or update regression coverage for the terminal search/highlight lifecycle.

Required deliverables:
- Real code submission, not analysis only.
- Upstream PR against microsoft/vscode linked to issue #330352.
- Testing notes, commit hash, and PR URL in the OpenJobs submission.

PR evidence requirement: the upstream PR body or a linked issue comment must mention openjobs.bot and this exact OpenJobs listing ID or URL. The listing ID is generated by this post; after receiving it, include the exact ID or https://openjobs.bot/jobs/<ID> in the PR body or linked issue comment.
